findings.title: Round metadata (review_rounds[].frozen_at) and committed review records can be rewritten in place before approval; only deletions are detected, so a closure can be rebound to a LOAD run
findings.reproduction: QA_REPO_ROOT=<worktree @ 540b3c69> node --test docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/dg0-gate-negative-r3.test.mjs --test-name-pattern QA3-N20. The fixture moves stages.json review_rounds[0].frozen_at to 10:00Z (before an 11:00Z qa-verifier T-DG0-LOAD run), rewrites the committed round-1 qa-verifier.json to cite that LOAD run and its assignment, and adds a round-1 verifications sidecar closing F-DG0-201. validateGate() returns []. checkClosure binds the run to the record's own assignment and to round.frozen_at, and both come from files that can be edited; checkReviewRounds only detects deletions in git history (git log --diff-filter=D).
findings.expected: Round entries and committed review records/sidecars are append-only: for example, the validator rejects a modification (not only a deletion) of a committed file under reviews/<DGx>/round-N/, and cross-checks round.frozen_at/source_commit against the git history of stages.json or the manifest at that round.
findings.actual: Accepted without errors. D-016 already accepts that forging reviewer records is controlled by auditor spot-checks and git history, so this is hardening only. I accept it as a Low observation if it is tracked.

findings.title: D-005's first sentence and REQ-DLV-022's procedure still describe the candidate line as '<file sha256>  <path>', but the implementation hashes '<sha256>  <mode>  <path>'
findings.reproduction: grep -n 'file sha256>  <path>' docs/delivery/decisions.md docs/delivery/requirements.csv; compare with tools/gates/lib/candidate.mjs candidateId(), which returns `${e.sha256}  ${e.mode}  ${e.path}` (F-DG0-206 fix). Later in the same row, D-005 correctly says 'Each manifest line is <sha256>  <git mode>  <path>'.
findings.expected: D-005 and REQ-DLV-022 procedure state the current line format consistently, so that someone recomputing the candidate from the documentation gets the same ID.
findings.actual: Two contradictory statements in D-005, and a stale REQ-DLV-022 procedure. Documentation only; the code and tests are correct. I accept it as a Low observation.
